Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description:
An immutable, hashable, bitemporal record.

`payload` is canonicalised on construction (Decimals become text, floats are
rejected, datetimes become UTC "Z" strings, text becomes NFC) and then deep-frozen:
mappings become `FrozenDict`, lists become tuples (they dump back as JSON lists).

FactDraft.title: FactDraft
FactDraft.description: A human-supplied fact. `origin`, `review_state` and `extraction_id` are set by the server.

Finding.title: Finding

PolicyDocument-Input.title: PolicyDocument
PolicyDocument-Input.description: The whole policy. Its `policy_digest` identifies it; it is never edited in place.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description: A Decimal amount (exactly 3 dp) with a unit. JSON form: canonical text, e.g. "5".

Reconstruction.title: Reconstruction
Reconstruction.description: Outcome of replaying a stored evaluation. A mismatch is data, never an exception.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One line of arithmetic: the formula with the numbers substituted, and its value.
